conclusion: No blocking defects found in the reviewed candidate build, Node decision replay, freeze verification, and whole-group blind-screen integration.

nonblocking_findings.issue: The fixed coverage-index.json is created exclusively before the scan. If scanning subsequently fails, rerunning the wrapper stops because the index already exists.
nonblocking_findings.recommendation: In a later version, permit recovery only after byte-for-byte validation of the existing index, or accept a new checks output directory. Keep the present successful run and frozen artifacts unchanged.

limitations: The Node replay verifies offline adapter and guard behavior, not authentication, database ownership, or end-to-end execution.
The code review is not an independent semantic annotation of all stories.
Zero lexical-screen matches are not proof of semantic independence.
